notes: Card: year digits in '(2004)', '(2014)', '(2015)' after author lists; the two strongest examples are instead the type name in a C cast '(char*)', '(BYTE*)' (probe: '(int*)' 0.96), which this test does not cover. Probes: reference years 0.58 / 0.54; '(2009)' in prose 0.03, bare year 0.01.
